2Q'26 Preview: Expect a solid Quarter, with Guidance reiteration to underpin latest Vara Consensus

Bayer will report 2Q'26 results on Tuesday, August 4, 2026 at 6:30am BST (7:30am CEST/1:30am ET), followed by an investor conference call at 1pm BST (2pm CEST/8am ET); dial-in details TBC. On 2Q'26 Sales: We forecast Group Sales of €10,687m, broadly in-line with BBG Consensus of €10,721m, with our expectations for c. 1% higher Consumer sales offset by our c. 1% lower Pharma and slightly lower Crop forecasts. On 2Q'26 EBITDA (u/l): We forecast EBITDA (u/l) of €1,939m, c. 1% below BBG Consensus at €1,956m, with our expectation for better profitability in Pharma [EBITDA (u/l) of €1,038m vs. €1,023m] offset by greater costs in Reconciliation [EBITDA (u/l) of €149m vs. €110m]. On Core EPS: we forecast Core EPS of €0.73, c. 4% below BBG Consensus at €0.76 (although we believe Consensus does not fully reflect the new Core EPS reporting approach, and so we wait for Vara Consensus for a more accurate reflection of Consensus expectations for Core EPS). On the FY'26 guidance, we expect Bayer to reiterate its guidance at CER for Group Sales growth of “0% to +3%” (€45bn to 47bn), with a -1% FX (or -€0.5bn) headwind on sales leading to a reported sales range of €44.5bn to €46.5bn. On EBITDA (u/l), we expect that Bayer will also reiterate its guidance for “-1% to +4%” growth at CER (€9.6-10.1bn) with a -2% FX (or -€0.2bn) headwind, leading to a reported range of €9.4-9.9bn. This leads us to expect the Core EPS guidance at CER will also remain at ~€4.30-€4.80, with a €0.20 FX headwind leading to an unchanged reported Core EPS range of €4.10-4.60. With latest Vara Consensus broadly in line with the middle of these ranges, including for Core EPS at €4.32, we do not expect any changes following the results. Overall, we expect the 2Q'26 results to come broadly in-line with BBG Consensus expectations, but anticipate a reiteration of the guidance that will underpin FY'26 Vara Consensus forecasts and hence expect the results to have limited impact on the shares.
